title: Idioms & Collocations
sub: Natural idioms and word pairings for work and conversation.

cards.def:
To make a mistake by failing to do something
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदारी निभाने में चूक जाना
examples: We dropped the ball on communicating the delay.
I dropped the ball and forgot to book the hotel.
The vendor dropped the ball on the delivery date.
Don't drop the ball on the follow-up email.

cards.def:
To keep someone informed
हिंदी: किसी को जानकारी में बनाए रखना
examples: Please keep me in the loop on the vendor discussions.
Keep your parents in the loop about your travel plans.
Please keep the client in the loop if anything changes.
She kept her manager in the loop with weekly updates.

cards.def:
Not informed about recent developments
हिंदी: ताज़ा जानकारी से अनजान
examples: I've been on leave, so I'm out of the loop.
I felt out of the loop after missing the meeting.
New joiners often feel out of the loop for a few weeks.
Sorry, I'm out of the loop; what happened?

cards.def:
Being planned or developed
हिंदी: योजना या तैयारी में
examples: There are three new features in the pipeline.
A new metro line is in the pipeline for our area.
We have two big deals in the pipeline this quarter.
Is a salary revision in the pipeline?

cards.def:
Temporarily postponed or given low priority
हिंदी: कम प्राथमिकता पर रखा हुआ
examples: The refactor was put on the back burner.
My plan to learn guitar is on the back burner.
The new office project is on the back burner until next year.
Put the minor bugs on the back burner for now.

cards.def:
About to happen soon
हिंदी: जल्द आने वाला
examples: A major platform upgrade is on the horizon.
With exams on the horizon, the students are busy.
There's a promotion on the horizon for her.
Big changes are on the horizon for the industry.

cards.def:
Uncertain and risky as to outcome
हिंदी: अनिश्चित और जोखिम भरा
examples: It was touch and go before the cutover succeeded.
It was touch and go whether we'd catch the flight.
The patient's condition was touch and go overnight.
The deal was touch and go until the last minute.

cards.def:
Continuing until the last possible moment
हिंदी: आख़िरी क्षण तक
examples: The project went down to the wire.
The cricket match went down to the wire.
The election result came down to the wire.
Our submission went down to the wire, but we made it.

cards.def:
Rushing to finish within limited time
हिंदी: समय से होड़ लगाकर
examples: We worked against the clock to restore service.
Students raced against the clock to finish the paper.
The chef worked against the clock to prepare the feast.
Rescuers worked against the clock after the flood.

cards.def:
Under intense pressure
हिंदी: भारी दबाव में
examples: The team was under the gun to fix the bug.
I'm under the gun with three reports due today.
The team was under the gun before the client visit.
She works best when she's under the gun.

cards.def:
Not noticed by many people
हिंदी: चुपचाप, बिना ध्यान में आए
examples: The issue stayed under the radar for months.
The small startup flew under the radar for years.
He stayed under the radar and avoided office politics.
The problem went under the radar until customers complained.

cards.def:
A situation that creates many unexpected problems
हिंदी: उलझनों से भरा मामला
examples: Changing the schema opened a can of worms.
Asking about the old dispute opened a can of worms.
Changing the pay structure could open a can of worms.
Don't open that can of worms at the family dinner.

cards.def:
Two bad things happening together
हिंदी: दोहरी मार
examples: Late files and a system outage were a double whammy.
Losing my job and my phone in one week was a double whammy.
Rain and a power cut were a double whammy for the event.
Higher prices and lower salaries are a double whammy for families.

cards.def:
A rare combination of bad factors
हिंदी: बुरे हालात का दुर्लभ संगम
examples: Holidays and a vendor change created a perfect storm.
Heavy rain and a strike created a perfect storm for commuters.
Low staff and high demand were a perfect storm at the hospital.
The company faced a perfect storm of debt and falling sales.

cards.def:
A chain reaction of events
हिंदी: एक के बाद एक असर पड़ना
examples: One failure caused a domino effect across teams.
One late train caused a domino effect of delays.
The bank's failure had a domino effect on other lenders.
A missed deadline can have a domino effect on the whole plan.

cards.def:
An indirect consequence
हिंदी: अप्रत्यक्ष परिणाम
examples: The delay had a knock-on effect on testing.
The fuel price rise had a knock-on effect on food prices.
His absence had a knock-on effect on the team's work.
Road closures have a knock-on effect on local shops.

cards.def:
A situation growing quickly from small beginnings
हिंदी: छोटी बात का तेज़ी से बड़ा हो जाना
examples: Minor errors had a snowball effect.
Small savings have a snowball effect over time.
One rumour created a snowball effect on social media.
Late payments had a snowball effect on our cash flow.

cards.def:
A task that is hard to learn at first
हिंदी: शुरुआत में सीखना कठिन
examples: Kubernetes has a steep learning curve.
The new job had a steep learning curve.
Learning to drive in city traffic is a steep learning curve.
The software has a steep learning curve for beginners.

cards.def:
A difficult problem to solve
हिंदी: सुलझाने में कठिन समस्या
examples: The race condition was a tough nut to crack.
The new client is a tough nut to crack.
This maths problem is a tough nut to crack.
Getting my father to try new food is a tough nut to crack.

cards.def:
An attempt with little chance of success
हिंदी: कम सफलता की संभावना वाला प्रयास
examples: It's a long shot, but let's try restarting the consumer.
Getting tickets for the final is a long shot.
It's a long shot, but I've applied for the scholarship.
Winning the lottery is a very long shot.

cards.word: a step in the right direction
cards.def:
An action that moves towards a good result
हिंदी: सही दिशा में कदम
examples: The new alerts are a step in the right direction.
Cutting sugar from my tea is a step in the right direction.
The new bike lanes are a step in the right direction.
Talking to each other again is a step in the right direction.

cards.def:
A very small amount compared with what is needed
हिंदी: ऊँट के मुँह में जीरा
examples: The extra budget is a drop in the ocean.
My donation was a drop in the ocean compared to what's needed.
The pay rise is a drop in the ocean against inflation.
Ten trees are a drop in the ocean for the city.

cards.word: the final nail in the coffin
cards.def:
An event that causes the end of something
हिंदी: अंतिम निर्णायक चोट
examples: The cost overrun was the final nail in the project's coffin.
The bad review was the final nail in the coffin for the restaurant.
Losing the last client was the final nail in the coffin.
His rude comment was the final nail in the coffin of their friendship.

cards.word: the writing is on the wall
cards.def:
Signs show that something bad is about to happen
हिंदी: आने वाली बुरी स्थिति के स्पष्ट संकेत
examples: The writing was on the wall for the legacy platform.
After three bad quarters, the writing is on the wall.
When the shop stopped ordering stock, the writing was on the wall.
The writing is on the wall for petrol cars.

cards.def:
The situation has become calm after confusion
हिंदी: हालात शांत हो गए हैं
examples: Let's review once the dust has settled.
After the dust has settled, we'll discuss what went wrong.
Wait until the dust has settled before making big decisions.
Once the dust had settled, the merger worked well.

cards.def:
A quiet period before a stressful event
हिंदी: तूफ़ान से पहले की शांति
examples: The quiet morning was the calm before the storm.
The empty shop at noon was the calm before the storm.
Sunday evening is the calm before the storm of the work week.
The silence in the exam hall felt like the calm before the storm.

cards.def:
An event that alerts people to a problem
हिंदी: चेतावनी जगाने वाली घटना
examples: The outage was a wake-up call for resilience.
The health scare was a wake-up call to start exercising.
Failing the test was a wake-up call for him.
The flood was a wake-up call for city planners.

cards.def:
A warning sign of a problem
हिंदी: ख़तरे का संकेत
examples: Missing audit logs are a red flag.
A job offer without an interview is a red flag.
Constant lying is a red flag in any relationship.
Very high returns are a red flag for scams.

cards.def:
A situation not clearly defined by rules
हिंदी: अस्पष्ट क्षेत्र
examples: Data sharing between teams is a grey area.
Using office printers for personal work is a grey area.
Freelancing while employed can be a grey area.
The law on drones is still a grey area.

cards.def:
A decisive test of quality or success
हिंदी: निर्णायक कसौटी
examples: The migration is a litmus test for the new design.
The first month is a litmus test for any new hire.
The election is a litmus test for the new party.
How a company treats complaints is a litmus test of its values.

cards.def:
The lowest quality or last available option
हिंदी: सबसे निचला विकल्प
examples: We've reached the bottom of the barrel for quick fixes.
The last few rental flats were the bottom of the barrel.
We're scraping the bottom of the barrel for ideas.
Those leftover snacks are the bottom of the barrel.

cards.def:
Strictly following the rules
हिंदी: नियमों के अनुसार
examples: Compliance requires doing everything by the book.
The new accountant does everything by the book.
Police must do the search by the book.
Let's play this by the book to avoid trouble.

cards.def:
To act slightly outside the rules
हिंदी: नियमों में ढील देना
examples: We can't bend the rules for audit evidence.
The teacher bent the rules and let me submit late.
Don't bend the rules just because a friend asks.
Sometimes managers bend the rules for good reasons.

cards.def:
To avoid risk
हिंदी: जोखिम से बचना
examples: Let's play it safe and roll back.
I'll play it safe and leave early for the airport.
Play it safe and back up your files.
Investors played it safe and bought gold.

cards.def:
To politely decline now but suggest later
हिंदी: बाद के लिए टालना
examples: Let me take a rain check on the meeting.
Can I take a rain check on dinner tonight?
I'm tired, so I'll take a rain check on the movie.
She took a rain check on the coffee invite.

cards.def:
To assume leadership of a task
हिंदी: नेतृत्व संभालना
examples: She took the lead on the incident response.
Who will take the lead on the new project?
She took the lead in organising the office party.
Our team took the lead in the second half.

cards.def:
A fresh start with no preconceptions
हिंदी: साफ़ शुरुआत
examples: A new project gives us a blank slate.
Moving to a new city felt like a blank slate.
The new year gives us a blank slate to set goals.
The new manager started with a blank slate.

cards.def:
To cause surprise or disapproval
हिंदी: हैरानी या असहमति पैदा करना
examples: The cost estimate raised a few eyebrows.
His expensive car raised eyebrows in the office.
The quick approval raised eyebrows among auditors.
Her casual dress at the interview raised eyebrows.

cards.def:
To cause trouble by upsetting a stable situation
हिंदी: स्थिति बिगाड़ना
examples: He didn't want to rock the boat before the release.
I didn't want to rock the boat by complaining.
New joiners usually avoid rocking the boat.
Don't rock the boat right before the big deal closes.

cards.def:
To upset people
हिंदी: लोगों को नाराज़ करना
examples: The new policy ruffled a few feathers.
Her honest comments ruffled feathers in the meeting.
The new seating plan ruffled some feathers.
He tends to ruffle feathers with his blunt emails.

cards.def:
To take responsibility for solving something
हिंदी: समस्या की ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
examples: Own the problem and update stakeholders regularly.
If you own the problem, people will trust you.
The new manager owned the problem and fixed the delays.
Don't wait for others; own the problem and act.

cards.def:
To accept responsibility for a mistake
हिंदी: दोष स्वीकार करना
examples: She took the blame for the missed alert.
The captain took the blame for the team's loss.
Why should I take the blame for your mistake?
He took the blame to protect his junior.

cards.def:
To make someone else seem responsible
हिंदी: दोष दूसरे पर डालना
examples: Don't shift the blame; fix the process.
Politicians often shift the blame to the previous government.
He tried to shift the blame to the vendor.
Shifting the blame won't solve the problem.

cards.def:
To shift responsibility to someone else
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदारी दूसरों पर टालना
examples: Teams kept passing the buck on data ownership.
Government offices often pass the buck between departments.
Don't pass the buck; take responsibility.
Each manager passed the buck, and nothing got done.

cards.def:
I take final responsibility
हिंदी: अंतिम ज़िम्मेदारी मेरी है
examples: As the lead, the buck stops here.
As the owner, the buck stops here.
The president said the buck stops here, not with his staff.
When a project fails, the buck stops with the leader.

cards.def:
To use influence to get something done
हिंदी: प्रभाव का उपयोग करके काम निकालना
examples: He pulled strings to get approval quickly.
His uncle pulled strings to get him a job.
I can't pull strings to get you a ticket.
She refused to pull strings for her son's admission.

cards.def:
To make an offer more attractive
हिंदी: सौदे को आकर्षक बनाना
examples: They sweetened the deal with free support.
The shop sweetened the deal with free delivery.
To sweeten the deal, they offered a joining bonus.
The seller sweetened the deal by including the furniture.

cards.def:
To find a fair middle ground
हिंदी: संतुलन बनाना
examples: We must strike a balance between speed and safety.
Try to strike a balance between work and family.
The new law strikes a balance between safety and freedom.
It's hard to strike a balance between quality and cost.

cards.def:
To reach an agreement
हिंदी: समझौता करना
examples: We struck a deal with the vendor.
We struck a deal with the landlord for lower rent.
The two companies struck a deal after months of talks.
I struck a deal with my son: homework first, then games.

cards.def:
To produce an emotional or relatable response
हिंदी: दिल को छू लेना
examples: Her story struck a chord with the audience.
The song struck a chord with young listeners.
His speech about hard work struck a chord with me.
The advert struck a chord with working mothers.

cards.def:
To establish the mood or standard
हिंदी: माहौल या मानक तय करना
examples: Leaders set the tone for team culture.
The opening speech set the tone for the conference.
A warm welcome sets the tone for a good visit.
The first meeting set the tone for the project.

cards.def:
To create an example for future cases
हिंदी: नज़ीर क़ायम करना
examples: The decision sets a precedent for future changes.
Giving him extra leave could set a precedent.
The court's decision set a precedent for similar cases.
We don't want to set a precedent of late payments.

cards.def:
To correct a misunderstanding
हिंदी: ग़लतफ़हमी दूर करना
examples: Let me set the record straight about the incident.
I want to set the record straight about what I said.
The company issued a statement to set the record straight.
She set the record straight about the rumours.

cards.def:
To help explain something
हिंदी: स्थिति पर प्रकाश डालना
examples: The logs shed light on the root cause.
The new book sheds light on the freedom struggle.
Can you shed light on why the order was cancelled?
The study sheds light on how children learn.

cards.def:
To make something seem less certain
हिंदी: संदेह पैदा करना
examples: The inconsistent results cast doubt on the model.
New evidence cast doubt on his story.
The poor results cast doubt on the new teaching method.
His late arrival cast doubt on his commitment.

cards.def:
To prepare for future development
हिंदी: आधार तैयार करना
examples: The pilot laid the groundwork for a full rollout.
Good schooling lays the groundwork for a successful career.
The first meeting laid the groundwork for the partnership.
We spent a month laying the groundwork before the launch.

cards.def:
To make future progress possible
हिंदी: आगे का रास्ता बनाना
examples: This change paves the way for real-time ingestion.
Her success paved the way for other women in the company.
The new law paves the way for cheaper medicines.
Early planning paved the way for a smooth wedding.

cards.def:
To allow a large amount of something to happen
हिंदी: बाढ़-सा प्रवाह शुरू कर देना
examples: One exception would open the floodgates for more.
Allowing one late fee waiver might open the floodgates.
The free offer opened the floodgates to thousands of sign-ups.
If we approve one request, we'll open the floodgates.

cards.def:
To change the course of a situation
हिंदी: हालात का रुख़ बदलना
examples: The hotfix turned the tide of the incident.
The new captain turned the tide for the team.
Public support turned the tide in her favour.
A single good review can turn the tide for a small shop.

cards.def:
To make one side more likely to win
हिंदी: संतुलन एक ओर झुकाना
examples: Cost savings tipped the balance in favour of the cloud.
Her experience tipped the balance in the final interview.
The lower rent tipped the balance in favour of the smaller flat.
One extra vote tipped the balance.

cards.def:
To increase risk or consequences
हिंदी: दाँव बढ़ाना
examples: The audit raised the stakes for compliance.
The client's deadline raised the stakes for the whole team.
Bringing in the CEO raised the stakes of the meeting.
Borrowing money to invest raises the stakes.

cards.word: put the cart before the horse
cards.def:
To do things in the wrong order
हिंदी: उल्टा क्रम अपनाना
examples: Designing the UI before requirements is putting the cart before the horse.
Buying furniture before finding a flat is putting the cart before the horse.
Hiring before we have funding is putting the cart before the horse.
Don't put the cart before the horse; plan first.

cards.def:
To waste time redoing what already exists
हिंदी: पहले से मौजूद चीज़ दोबारा बनाना
examples: Let's not reinvent the wheel; use the library.
Use last year's template instead of reinventing the wheel.
There's no need to reinvent the wheel for a simple form.
He always reinvents the wheel instead of asking for help.

cards.def:
To continue until the end
हिंदी: अंत तक डटे रहना
examples: This project can go the distance if we plan well.
Few startups go the distance.
She went the distance and finished the marathon.
This old car can still go the distance.

cards.def:
To exchange repeated discussion or movement
हिंदी: बार-बार आगे-पीछे होना
examples: We went back and forth on the API format.
We went back and forth about where to eat.
The emails went back and forth for a week.
After going back and forth, we chose the blue design.

cards.def:
To stray from the intended course
हिंदी: पटरी से उतरना
examples: The discussion went off track quickly.
The meeting went off track when someone mentioned the bonus.
My diet went off track during the holidays.
Keep an agenda so the call doesn't go off track.

cards.def:
To receive permission to go ahead
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ने की अनुमति मिलना
examples: We got the green light for the migration.
The film finally got the green light from the producers.
Once we get the green light, we'll start hiring.
She got the green light to work from home.

cards.def:
To approve
हिंदी: मंज़ूरी देना
examples: Security gave the thumbs up to the design.
My father gave the thumbs up to my travel plan.
The client gave the thumbs up to the new logo.
The doctor gave me the thumbs up to start running again.

cards.word: give someone the benefit of the doubt
cards.def:
To trust someone when unsure
हिंदी: संदेह का लाभ देना
examples: I gave the vendor the benefit of the doubt.
He's new, so let's give him the benefit of the doubt.
I gave my neighbour the benefit of the doubt about the noise.
The teacher gave the student the benefit of the doubt.

cards.def:
To deal with every possibility
हिंदी: हर संभावना को कवर करना
examples: The test plan covers all the bases.
We packed medicines, snacks and maps to cover all the bases.
The lawyer covered all the bases before the hearing.
Ask a few more questions to cover all the bases.

cards.def:
To monitor someone or something
हिंदी: निगरानी रखना
examples: I keep tabs on all open incidents.
Parents should keep tabs on their children's screen time.
I keep tabs on my spending with an app.
The manager keeps tabs on project deadlines.

cards.def:
To stay calm
हिंदी: शांत रहना
examples: She kept her cool during the escalation.
Keep your cool even when the customer shouts.
He kept his cool in the traffic jam.
It's hard to keep your cool when you're tired.

cards.def:
To suddenly become angry
हिंदी: आपा खो देना
examples: He lost his temper over the repeated mistakes.
I lost my temper when the cab driver cancelled again.
Try not to lose your temper with your children.
The coach lost his temper after the defeat.

cards.def:
To release stress or anger harmlessly
हिंदी: भड़ास निकालना
examples: A quick walk helps me let off steam.
I play badminton after work to let off steam.
The kids let off steam in the park after school.
Writing in a diary helps me let off steam.

cards.def:
To release pent-up energy or frustration
हिंदी: तनाव निकालना
examples: We blow off steam with a Friday game.
The team blew off steam at a karaoke night.
Students blow off steam after exams with a party.
He went for a run to blow off steam.

cards.def:
To work through the entire night
हिंदी: पूरी रात जागकर काम करना
examples: He pulled an all-nighter to fix the outage.
I pulled an all-nighter to finish my college project.
Pulling an all-nighter before an exam isn't a good idea.
She pulled an all-nighter to prepare the pitch.

cards.def:
To work continuously day and night
हिंदी: दिन-रात लगातार काम करना
examples: Engineers worked around the clock during the incident.
Hospital staff worked around the clock during the outbreak.
The factory works around the clock in the festival season.
Volunteers worked around the clock to pack food.

cards.def:
To balance competing tasks
हिंदी: प्राथमिकताओं में संतुलन बनाना
examples: Seniors must juggle priorities daily.
Working mothers juggle priorities every day.
Learning to juggle priorities is key for new managers.
She juggles priorities between two big clients.

cards.def:
To become less effective through overuse
हिंदी: घिस जाना / असर खोना
examples: Our patience is wearing thin with the vendor.
His excuses are starting to wear thin.
The joke wore thin after the third time.
My patience wore thin after waiting an hour.

cards.def:
To lose energy or momentum
हिंदी: जोश खो देना
examples: The initiative ran out of steam after the reorg.
I ran out of steam halfway through the long hike.
The campaign ran out of steam after a month.
By Friday afternoon, the team had run out of steam.

cards.def:
To gain popularity or progress
हिंदी: ज़ोर पकड़ना
examples: The new tool is gaining traction across teams.
The idea of a four-day week is gaining traction.
Her online shop gained traction after a viral video.
Electric scooters are gaining traction in small towns.

cards.def:
To progress faster over time
हिंदी: गति पकड़ना
examples: The migration gained momentum in the second month.
The campaign gained momentum after celebrities joined.
Her career gained momentum after the promotion.
The project gained momentum once the team was complete.

cards.def:
To encounter an unexpected problem
हिंदी: अचानक अड़चन आना
examples: We hit a snag with permissions.
Our travel plans hit a snag when the train was cancelled.
The house sale hit a snag over missing papers.
We hit a snag with the payment gateway.

cards.def:
To be unable to make further progress
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ना असंभव हो जाना
examples: We hit a wall trying to scale the database.
I hit a wall in my studies and needed a break.
The negotiations hit a wall over salary.
Runners often hit a wall near the end of a marathon.

cards.def:
To become extremely angry
हिंदी: आग-बबूला हो जाना
examples: The client hit the roof when the report was wrong.
Dad hit the roof when he saw the phone bill.
The manager hit the roof over the missed deadline.
She'll hit the roof if you're late again.

cards.def:
To have great success or luck
हिंदी: बड़ी सफलता पाना
examples: We hit the jackpot hiring someone with her skills.
We hit the jackpot with this flat; it's cheap and close to work.
The restaurant hit the jackpot with its new dish.
I hit the jackpot at the sale and found everything I needed.

cards.def:
To succeed with excellent results
हिंदी: शानदार नतीजों के साथ सफल होना
examples: She passed the certification with flying colours.
He passed his driving test with flying colours.
The new app passed the security review with flying colours.
She passed her board exams with flying colours.

cards.def:
To succeed easily
हिंदी: आसानी से पार कर जाना
examples: He sailed through the system design round.
She sailed through the interview.
With good preparation, you'll sail through the exam.
The proposal sailed through the board meeting.

cards.def:
To succeed with difficulty
हिंदी: मुश्किल से पास होना
examples: We scraped through the audit.
I scraped through maths with just enough marks.
The team scraped through to the final.
The company scraped through the difficult year.

cards.def:
To fail to reach a standard
हिंदी: अपेक्षा से कम रह जाना
examples: The results fell short of expectations.
The film fell short of fans' expectations.
Our sales fell short of the target by ten percent.
The hotel fell short of what the photos promised.

cards.def:
To be insufficient or fail to achieve
हिंदी: कम पड़ जाना
examples: Our estimate came up short by two weeks.
We came up short on chairs for the guests.
The team came up short in the final match.
When I counted the money, it came up short.

cards.word: at the end of the day
cards.def:
Ultimately; when everything is considered
हिंदी: आख़िरकार
examples: At the end of the day, reliability matters most.
At the end of the day, family matters most.
At the end of the day, it's your decision.
We can debate all we like, but at the end of the day, customers decide.

cards.def:
When a situation becomes critical
हिंदी: जब नौबत आ जाए
examples: When push comes to shove, we'll roll back.
When push comes to shove, he always helps his friends.
When push comes to shove, we'll hire a contractor.
Families stick together when push comes to shove.

cards.def:
Over a long period of time
हिंदी: लंबे समय में
examples: Investing in tests pays off in the long run.
Eating healthy food saves money in the long run.
Learning English will help your career in the long run.
Cheap shoes cost more in the long run.

cards.def:
Immediately and at the place
हिंदी: तुरंत वहीं
examples: He solved the bug on the spot.
The traffic police fined him on the spot.
She was offered the job on the spot.
I had to answer the question on the spot.

cards.def:
Without preparation
हिंदी: बिना तैयारी के
examples: Her off-the-cuff answer was surprisingly thorough.
He made an off the cuff remark that upset his boss.
Her speech was off the cuff but very funny.
I can't give a price off the cuff; let me check.

cards.def:
While in motion; without prior planning
हिंदी: चलते-चलते
examples: We adjusted the plan on the fly.
The singer changed the lyrics on the fly.
We had to translate on the fly during the meeting.
Good teachers adjust their lessons on the fly.

cards.def:
Temporarily
हिंदी: फ़िलहाल
examples: We'll use a workaround for the time being.
I'm staying with my cousin for the time being.
For the time being, the office is closed on Saturdays.
Let's use the old laptop for the time being.

cards.def:
Usually
हिंदी: ज़्यादातर
examples: More often than not, the cause is configuration.
More often than not, the bus is late.
More often than not, simple answers are the best.
He orders biryani more often than not.

cards.def:
Occasionally
हिंदी: कभी-कभार
examples: Every now and then, the feed arrives twice.
Every now and then, I call my old school friends.
We eat out every now and then.
Every now and then, the Wi-Fi drops.

cards.def:
Rare and widely separated
हिंदी: बहुत कम और दूर-दूर
examples: Good documentation is few and far between.
Good tailors are few and far between these days.
Holidays are few and far between in this job.
Petrol pumps are few and far between on that highway.

cards.def:
Usually
हिंदी: आम तौर पर
examples: As a rule, we freeze changes on Fridays.
As a rule, I don't check emails after nine.
As a rule, the shop doesn't give refunds.
As a rule, we reply to customers within a day.

cards.def:
A short statement of the main point
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त सार
examples: Give me an in-a-nutshell summary of the incident.
She gave an in a nutshell summary of the book.
Start your email with an in a nutshell summary.
Can I get an in a nutshell summary of the meeting?

cards.word: in the grand scheme of things
cards.def:
Considering the overall situation
हिंदी: बड़ी योजना के संदर्भ में
examples: In the grand scheme of things, this delay is minor.
In the grand scheme of things, a bad exam isn't the end.
Losing one match doesn't matter in the grand scheme of things.
In the grand scheme of things, this small cost is nothing.

cards.def:
At risk of being lost
हिंदी: दाँव पर
examples: Client trust is at stake.
Our reputation is at stake if we miss the deadline.
With jobs at stake, the union called a strike.
There's a lot of money at stake in this deal.

cards.def:
In disagreement with
हिंदी: असंगत / विरोध में
examples: The data is at odds with the report.
His actions are at odds with his words.
The two departments are often at odds with each other.
This result is at odds with earlier studies.

cards.def:
As a whole; in general
हिंदी: कुल मिलाकर / आम तौर पर
examples: The public at large lacks awareness.
The thief is still at large.
The decision affects society at large.
The internet has changed the world at large.

cards.def:
Close by; being dealt with
हिंदी: हाथ में / सामने
examples: Let's focus on the issue at hand.
Keep your documents at hand during the visa interview.
Help is at hand if you need it.
Let's deal with the problem at hand first.

cards.def:
Ideas being developed
हिंदी: विकासाधीन विचार
examples: Plenty of ideas are in the pipeline.
We have many new products in the pipeline of ideas.
Her notebook is a pipeline of ideas for future stories.
Keep a pipeline of ideas for the next campaign.

cards.def:
Stuck in a boring routine
हिंदी: एक ही ढर्रे में फँसा
examples: After five years, he felt stuck in a rut.
I was in a rut, so I joined a dance class.
Travel helps you get out of a rut.
The team was in a rut until the new manager arrived.

cards.def:
Involved in something too difficult
हिंदी: क्षमता से बड़ी ज़िम्मेदारी में फँसा
examples: I felt in over my head during my first on-call.
He's in over his head with three part-time jobs.
I agreed to cook for fifty people and was soon in over my head.
Ask for help before you get in over your head.

cards.def:
In a situation too difficult to handle
हिंदी: क्षमता से बाहर
examples: She felt out of her depth in the architecture review.
I was out of my depth in the advanced maths class.
The new manager seemed out of his depth with the client.
Don't be afraid to say when you're out of your depth.

cards.def:
Impossible or not allowed
हिंदी: असंभव
examples: Skipping the security review is out of the question.
A holiday this month is out of the question.
Cheating in the exam is out of the question.
Buying a car right now is out of the question.

cards.def:
Not aware of recent developments
हिंदी: ताज़ा हालात से कटा हुआ
examples: Leaders can become out of touch with day-to-day issues.
My grandparents feel out of touch with modern technology.
The politician seemed out of touch with ordinary people.
I've been abroad, so I'm out of touch with local news.

cards.def:
Extremely happy
हिंदी: बेहद ख़ुश
examples: I'm over the moon about the promotion.
She was over the moon when she got into the college.
My parents were over the moon about the new baby.
The team was over the moon after winning the cup.

cards.def:
To feel exhausted from stress
हिंदी: थकान और तनाव महसूस करना
examples: I felt burnt out after the release marathon.
Many nurses feel burnt out after long shifts.
Take a holiday before you feel burnt out.
I felt burnt out after months of night calls with the US team.

cards.def:
An obviously easy decision
हिंदी: बिना सोचे लिया जाने वाला फ़ैसला
examples: Automating the check is a no-brainer.
Taking the metro instead of driving was a no-brainer.
With that salary, accepting the offer is a no-brainer.
Saving money on electricity with LED bulbs is a no-brainer.

cards.def:
An outcome good for everyone
हिंदी: दोनों पक्षों के लिए फ़ायदेमंद स्थिति
examples: Shared tooling is a win-win for both teams.
Carpooling is a win-win situation for everyone.
The internship was a win-win situation for the student and the company.
Let's find a win-win situation for both sides.

cards.def:
Something unpleasant but unavoidable
हिंदी: अनिवार्य बुराई
examples: Some say compliance reviews are a necessary evil.
Traffic jams are a necessary evil of city life.
Many people see taxes as a necessary evil.
Long meetings can be a necessary evil in big projects.

cards.def:
A controversial issue nobody wants to handle
हिंदी: विवादित मुद्दा जिसे कोई नहीं छूना चाहता
examples: Data ownership is a hot potato here.
The salary issue became a hot potato in the meeting.
Nobody wanted to handle the hot potato of the layoffs.
The new tax is a political hot potato.

cards.def:
A subject of ongoing disagreement
हिंदी: विवाद की जड़
examples: The release schedule is a bone of contention.
The TV remote is a bone of contention in our house.
Parking spaces are a bone of contention among neighbours.
Work hours remain a bone of contention with the union.

cards.def:
A rough practical guideline
हिंदी: मोटा व्यावहारिक नियम
examples: As a rule of thumb, keep functions short.
As a rule of thumb, save ten percent of your salary.
A good rule of thumb is to reply to emails within a day.
As a rule of thumb, arrive two hours before an international flight.

cards.def:
The best example against which others are judged
हिंदी: सर्वोत्तम मानक
examples: Her design doc is the gold standard for the team.
This hospital is the gold standard for heart surgery.
Her customer service is the gold standard in our company.
The test is considered the gold standard for diagnosis.

cards.def:
A spreading chain of consequences
हिंदी: लहर जैसा फैलता असर
examples: The change had a ripple effect across services.
One kind act can have a ripple effect in a community.
The price change had a ripple effect on other products.
His resignation had a ripple effect across the team.

cards.def:
A rough approximate figure
हिंदी: मोटा अनुमान
examples: Give me a ballpark estimate by noon.
Can you give me a ballpark estimate for the repair?
The builder's ballpark estimate was ten lakh rupees.
A ballpark estimate is enough for now.

cards.def:
To make small adjustments to improve
हिंदी: बारीक सुधार करना
examples: We fine-tuned the retry settings.
The singer fine-tuned her performance before the show.
We fine-tuned the budget after the review.
Fine-tune your resume for each job application.

cards.def:
To focus on what matters amid distractions
हिंदी: शोर के बीच ज़रूरी चीज़ पहचानना
examples: Good dashboards cut through the noise.
A short, clear email can cut through the noise.
Good leaders cut through the noise and focus on goals.
This news app helps you cut through the noise.

cards.def:
To see how separate facts are related
हिंदी: बिखरे तथ्यों को जोड़कर समझना
examples: She connected the dots between the two outages.
The detective connected the dots and solved the case.
When I connected the dots, I understood why he left.
Help your audience connect the dots with simple examples.

cards.def:
Thinking in a similar way
हिंदी: एक जैसी सोच पर
examples: We're on the same wavelength about priorities.
My best friend and I are always on the same wavelength.
The designer and the client weren't on the same wavelength.
It's easy to work with people on the same wavelength.

cards.def:
To understand each other well
हिंदी: एक ही भाषा में समझना
examples: Business and engineering must speak the same language.
The doctors and nurses speak the same language about patient care.
Sales and finance don't always speak the same language.
Once we spoke the same language, the project moved fast.

cards.def:
To learn how to do something
हिंदी: काम का तरीका सीख लेना
examples: I'm getting the hang of system design interviews.
It took me a week to get the hang of the new phone.
You'll get the hang of driving after a few lessons.
She quickly got the hang of the billing software.

cards.def:
To improve existing knowledge of a subject
हिंदी: पुराने ज्ञान को ताज़ा करना
examples: I need to brush up on my vocabulary before IELTS.
I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
Brush up on basic maths before the aptitude test.
He brushed up on his Excel skills for the new job.

cards.def:
To improve by making small changes
हिंदी: निखारना
examples: I'll polish the draft before sending.
Polish your English by reading aloud every day.
She polished her speech until it was perfect.
Let's polish the slides before the client meeting.

cards.def:
To manage to survive a difficult period
हिंदी: मुश्किल दौर में टिके रहना
examples: We barely kept our heads above water during the migration.
With rising rent, many families struggle to keep their heads above water.
The shop kept its head above water during the slow months.
I'm busy, but I'm keeping my head above water.

cards.def:
Something done only to achieve another aim
हिंदी: लक्ष्य पाने का साधन
examples: Documentation is a means to an end, not the goal.
For him, the job is just a means to an end.
Exams are a means to an end, not the goal of learning.
Money is a means to an end, not happiness itself.

cards.def:
Hard work done for pleasure rather than reward
हिंदी: प्रेम से किया गया श्रम
examples: The open-source project is a labour of love.
Running the free library is a labour of love for her.
Restoring the old car was a labour of love.
The cookbook was a labour of love for my grandmother.

cards.def:
A situation with very different parts
हिंदी: दो हिस्सों वाला खेल
examples: The migration was a game of two halves.
The cricket match was a game of two halves.
My first year at college was a game of two halves.
The quarter was a game of two halves: a slow start, then strong sales.

cards.def:
Someone in an unfamiliar situation
हिंदी: अनजान माहौल में असहज व्यक्ति
examples: He felt like a fish out of water in his first meeting.
I felt like a fish out of water at the fancy party.
The village boy felt like a fish out of water in the city.
New managers can feel like a fish out of water.

cards.def:
Someone or something so good that it's hard to match
हिंदी: जिसका मुक़ाबला करना कठिन हो
examples: His handover was a hard act to follow.
The previous principal was a hard act to follow.
Her first album is a hard act to follow.
Last year's festival was a hard act to follow.

cards.def:
An achievement to be proud of
हिंदी: गौरव की उपलब्धि
examples: The certification is a feather in her cap.
Winning the award was a feather in his cap.
Getting the big client was a feather in her cap.
The successful launch is a feather in the team's cap.

cards.def:
A guess with little chance of being right
हिंदी: अँधेरे में तीर
examples: It's a shot in the dark, but try clearing the cache.
My answer to the quiz question was a shot in the dark.
Guessing the password was a shot in the dark.
It's a shot in the dark, but maybe she's at the library.

cards.def:
Very close in distance
हिंदी: बहुत पास
examples: The office is a stone's throw away from the station.
Our house is a stone's throw away from the beach.
The market is a stone's throw away from my office.
The school is a stone's throw away, so the kids walk.

cards.def:
A completely different matter
हिंदी: बिल्कुल अलग मामला
examples: Scaling globally is a different kettle of fish.
Teaching adults is a different kettle of fish from teaching kids.
Running a shop is a different kettle of fish from working in one.
Speaking English is easy for him, but writing is a different kettle of fish.

cards.def:
Something new and refreshing
हिंदी: ताज़गी भरा बदलाव
examples: The new lead was a breath of fresh air.
The new teacher was a breath of fresh air for the class.
Her honest reviews are a breath of fresh air.
A weekend in the hills was a breath of fresh air.

cards.def:
An extra good thing on top of something already good
हिंदी: सोने पे सुहागा
examples: The early delivery was the icing on the cake.
The job was great, and the free lunch was the icing on the cake.
Winning the match was good; the trophy was the icing on the cake.
A sunny day was the icing on the cake for the wedding.

cards.def:
Benefits of two different things together
हिंदी: दोनों दुनिया का फ़ायदा
examples: Hybrid work offers the best of both worlds.
Living near the city but close to nature is the best of both worlds.
Part-time study gives me the best of both worlds.
This phone offers the best of both worlds: good camera and long battery.

cards.def:
The largest part of something
हिंदी: सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा
examples: Infrastructure takes the lion's share of the budget.
Rent takes the lion's share of my salary.
The lion's share of the work was done by two people.
The big company took the lion's share of the market.

cards.def:
The leading edge of an effort
हिंदी: अग्रिम मोर्चा
examples: The platform team is the tip of the spear.
The research team is the tip of the spear in our new strategy.
Young volunteers were the tip of the spear in the clean-up drive.
Our sales team is the tip of the spear in the new market.

cards.def:
Detailed terms often overlooked
हिंदी: बारीक शर्तें
examples: Read the fine print of the vendor contract.
Always read the fine print before taking a loan.
The fine print said the offer was for new users only.
Hidden charges were in the fine print.

cards.def:
The complete details of something
हिंदी: पूरी बारीकियाँ
examples: She knows the ins and outs of the platform.
My uncle knows the ins and outs of the property market.
It takes months to learn the ins and outs of the job.
She explained the ins and outs of the visa process.

cards.def:
The practical details
हिंदी: बुनियादी व्यावहारिक विवरण
examples: Let's get into the nitty-gritty of the design.
Let's discuss the nitty-gritty of the wedding budget.
The manager left the nitty-gritty to the team.
The training covered the nitty-gritty of filing taxes.

cards.def:
A broad overview of a situation
हिंदी: समग्र दृष्टि
examples: Managers need the big picture view first.
Give the board the big picture view before the details.
The big picture view shows that sales are growing overall.
Step back and take the big picture view of your career.

cards.def:
Outside the limits of a project
हिंदी: दायरे से बाहर
examples: Reporting is beyond the scope of this release.
That request is beyond the scope of our contract.
The question is beyond the scope of today's lesson.
Mobile support is beyond the scope of phase one.

cards.def:
Close enough to achieve
हिंदी: पहुँच के भीतर
examples: The target is within reach if we stay focused.
A promotion is within reach if you keep performing.
With one more win, the title is within reach.
Keep your phone within reach during the delivery window.

cards.def:
More advanced than others
हिंदी: दूसरों से आगे
examples: Learning AI tools keeps you ahead of the curve.
The company stayed ahead of the curve by investing in research.
She's always ahead of the curve with fashion trends.
Learning data skills keeps you ahead of the curve.

cards.def:
Out of public view
हिंदी: पर्दे के पीछे
examples: A lot of effort goes on behind the scenes.
Many people work behind the scenes to make a film.
Behind the scenes, the team worked all weekend.
The video shows what happens behind the scenes at a restaurant.

cards.def:
Having the latest knowledge
हिंदी: ताज़ा जानकारी में
examples: Let me bring you up to speed on the incident.
I need a day to get up to speed after my holiday.
She brought the new joiner up to speed on the project.
Read these notes to get up to speed before the meeting.

cards.def:
Working properly
हिंदी: चालू और ठीक से काम करता
examples: The service was up and running within ten minutes.
The new office will be up and running by June.
It took an hour to get the printer up and running.
Once the website is up and running, we'll start selling.
